reason: Both meet every hard requirement (word count, sentence length, no semicolons, all five facts), but Response B's brief explanatory clauses ('This encourages everyone to pay on time', 'This helps prevent mistakes or misuse of funds') better serve a finance-novice reader by clarifying the purpose of each rule, whereas Response A's added sentence ('This applies to all procurement commitments above that value') is a redundant restatement that adds little comprehension value.
